newsitem.title: USA: Knape & Vogt Q2 aided by draw slide demand.
newsitem.headline: Knape & Vogt Q2 aided by draw slide demand.

text.p: Knape & Vogt Manufacturing Co attributed its improved December 31 second-quarter results to efficiencies in manufacturing generated by increased sales of drawer slides.
For the quarter, earnings rose to $0.31 a share from $0.24 a year earlier. Sales advanced to $41.8 million from $38.1 million.

President Al Perry said in a statement that gross profit margins were 24.7 percent for the quarter, up from 23.9 percent. He said this was driven by lower material costs and volume increases in sales of precision drawer slides.
"The sales gains were especially good news for us because our fiscal second quarter is historically our slowest in terms of revenues and overall market activity," Perry said.
